newsitem.title: UK: Greece tenders to buy up to 40kt low sulphur fuel.
newsitem.headline: Greece tenders to buy up to 40kt low sulphur fuel.

text.p: Greece's state oil company has issued a tender to buy up to 40,000 tonnes of low sulphur straight-run fuel oil, traders said.
The tender requires one 20,000 tonne cargo of straight-run fuel oil with a maximum sulphur content of 0.35 percent to be delivered between March 5 and 10.

An optional 20,000 tonne cargo with similar specifications may be required, according to the buyer's wishes, to be delivered in April or May. More exact dates for the optional cargo were not specified.
Traders expected that such tight sulphur specifications meant the tender was most likely to be filled with North African barrels.
